run_f_gold: run f_gold to count ways to break a number into three non-negative integer parts
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in test harness with 10 parameter sets
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses triple nested loops to enumerate all i+j+k==n combinations
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the O(n^3) brute-force approach with an O(1) mathematical formula
review_f_gold: review f_gold and the test harness that compares f_filled results against the gold reference
